title: Create Hero Component for Landing Page
description: Develop a new reusable Hero component for the application's landing page, encapsulating the headline, description, and CTA buttons.
details:
- Create a new directory `components/landing/` if it does not exist.
- Implement `components/landing/hero.tsx` as a functional React component in TypeScript.
- Use semantic HTML and Tailwind CSS for layout and styling.
- Leverage `shadcn/ui` components (e.g., `Button`) for CTA buttons.
- Include a clear headline, concise description, and two CTA buttons: 'Sign Up' and 'Sign In'.
- Use Next.js `<Link>` for navigation to `/sign-up` and `/sign-in`.
- Ensure the component is accessible (focus states, ARIA labels as needed).
- Make the component responsive using Tailwind's responsive classes.
test_strategy: Write unit tests for the Hero component to verify that the headline, description, and CTA buttons render correctly. Use snapshot testing to ensure UI consistency. Test that CTA buttons link to the correct routes. Check accessibility with axe or similar tools.

title: Implement Landing Page at Root Route
description: Create the main landing page at `app/page.tsx` and integrate the new Hero component.
details:
- Create a new file `app/page.tsx` if it does not exist.
- Import and render the Hero component from `components/landing/hero.tsx`.
- Ensure the page uses the global layout and theme provider for light/dark mode compatibility.
- Optionally, add additional landing page sections or visuals as needed for context, but keep the Hero section prominent at the top.
test_strategy: Manually verify that the landing page loads at the root route and displays the Hero section correctly. Check that the theme toggle works and the layout is consistent with the rest of the app.

title: Enhance Hero Section Styling and Responsiveness
description: Polish the Hero component's design for visual appeal and ensure full responsiveness across devices.
details:
- Refine Tailwind CSS classes for spacing, typography, and color to create a visually engaging hero area.
- Optionally add background gradients, images, or SVGs using Next.js `<Image>` for optimization.
- Test and adjust layout for mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
- Ensure the Hero section remains accessible and readable in both light and dark modes.
test_strategy: Perform visual regression testing across multiple screen sizes. Use browser dev tools to simulate devices. Validate that all text and buttons are legible and interactive in both light and dark themes.

title: Test CTA Navigation and Accessibility
description: Verify that the CTA buttons in the Hero section correctly navigate to the sign-in and sign-up pages and meet accessibility standards.
details:
- Use Playwright or Cypress to write E2E tests that click the CTA buttons and confirm navigation to `/sign-in` and `/sign-up`.
- Check keyboard navigation and focus order for accessibility.
- Validate ARIA attributes and color contrast for compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA.
test_strategy: Run automated E2E tests for navigation. Use accessibility testing tools (axe, Lighthouse) to check for violations. Manually test keyboard navigation and focus states.
